contact.writeHeading: Tell us what you have in mind.
contact.writeIntro: Who you are, and what brings you here. We read every message and reply by email.
contact.sentBody: Your message is on its way to {email}. We reply by email.
contact.errorBody: Your message could not be sent just now. Please try again in a moment, or write to us directly at
contact.privacy: We use your details only to reply to you.

projects.fallbackMeta: A field project by The Luigi Footprints Foundation.
projects.archiveNote: Every project is listed with its photograph and date. Where a write-up exists, it is linked.
projects.sponsorBody: Each fully fitted home costs US$14,000, and a funded unit carries a plaque with your name or your organisation's. Gifts of any size go toward the next one.

donate.chooseHeading: Every gift goes to the project you choose.
donate.chooseIntro: Pick a project to see what it needs and sponsor an item, or give where it is needed most.
donate.sponsorHeading: Something this project needs, with your name on it.
donate.sponsorIntro: Choose one or several. Each is a suggested gift towards that item.
donate.giveIntro: Whatever you give goes to this project.
donate.currentGeneral: Your gift to this project is {amount}. Adding again replaces it.
donate.amountsNote: Suggested amounts are a guide. Every gift, whatever its size, goes to the project you choose.
donate.empty: Nothing chosen yet. Choose a project, or give any amount.
donate.thankYouBody: Your gift to the Luigi Footprints Foundation is deeply appreciated. Paystack will email your receipt to {email}.
donate.paystackNote: Payments are processed by Paystack. The foundation's record of your payment names the project and items you chose.
donate.paystackCancelled: The payment was not completed. Your gift is still here whenever you are ready.
donate.paystackError: The payment could not be started. Please try again in a moment.
donate.noMethod: Online payment is not available right now. Please write to us to give.
